# Vendored frontend assets

Self-hosted so Content-Security-Policy can stay on `'self'` (no jsDelivr / Google Fonts).

| Package | Version | Path |
|---------|---------|------|
| `@tabler/core` | 1.0.0 | `tabler/` |
| `@tabler/icons-webfont` | 3.27.0 | `tabler-icons/` |
| `chart.js` | 4.4.1 | `chartjs/` |

Do not load these from a CDN. Refresh by replacing the files here and bumping the versions in this table.
